definition_en: the last main meal of the day, eaten in the evening
core_image: 傍晚餐桌上的热汤与灯光
scene: 傍晚灯光下，一家人围坐在摆着热汤的餐桌旁。The whole family gathered around the table for supper.
sceneCN: 这里 supper 是「晚餐、晚饭」（第 1 个义项：晚上吃的最后一顿正餐）；句意是一家人傍晚围桌吃晚饭。

pos.zh: 名词：晚餐；晚饭；（睡前小食）夜宵

derivatives.zh: 由 supper 加 time 构成，义为「晚饭时间」
同源关联词：一般认为与同一表示进食的词根有关，义为「汤」

senses.title: The evening meal
senses.definition: the last main meal of the day, eaten in the evening
senses.definitionCN: 一天中最后一顿正餐，在傍晚或晚上吃
senses.example: The whole family gathered around the table for supper.
senses.exampleCN: 全家人围坐在餐桌旁吃晚饭。
senses.why: The word grew from the idea of taking food late in the day, so the image is the evening table.
senses.whyCN: 这个词从「傍晚进食」的意思发展而来，核心意象就是傍晚的餐桌。

senses.title: A light late snack
senses.definition: a small meal eaten just before going to bed
senses.definitionCN: 临睡前吃的一顿简单的少量食物
senses.example: She had a glass of milk as a bedtime supper.
senses.exampleCN: 她睡前喝了杯牛奶当夜宵。
senses.why: When the evening meal shrinks to a bite before sleep, the word stretches to name it.
senses.whyCN: 当晚餐缩小成睡前的一点点食物，这个词就延伸用来称呼这份夜宵。

senses.title: An informal evening meal event
senses.definition: an evening meal organized as an event, often in a church or hall
senses.definitionCN: 在教堂、礼堂等场合组织的集体晚餐活动
senses.example: The village hall holds a fish supper every year.
senses.exampleCN: 村礼堂每年举办一次炸鱼晚餐会。
senses.why: A shared evening meal at a fixed place becomes a named social event.
senses.whyCN: 在固定场所共享的晚餐逐渐变成有名称的集体活动。

intro.en: Supper comes from an old word for eating or drinking soup in the evening.
intro.cn: supper 来自一个表示傍晚进食或喝汤的古词。

items.en: a reconstructed root *sup- meaning to eat or sip soup; sources mark it as a reconstruction.
items.cn: 一般认为存在一个表示「进食、啜汤」的重构词根 *sup-（属重构形式，存疑）。

items.en: souper meant to eat the evening meal, likely borrowed or reinforced from Germanic stock.
items.cn: 古法语 souper 指吃晚餐，一般认为借自或受日耳曼语同源词强化。

items.en: supper entered English through Old French, naming the evening meal.
items.cn: 十三世纪经古法语进入英语，指傍晚那顿饭。

items.en: supper was the main evening meal; the Last Supper fixed a famous religious use.
items.cn: supper 是一日的主晚餐；「最后晚餐」确立了著名的宗教用法。

items.en: in Britain supper can mean a light late snack, while dinner often names the main evening meal.
items.cn: 在英式用法里 supper 可指睡前小食，而主晚餐常改称 dinner。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the sup- spelling; the near-meaning group collects other meals of the day.
note.cn: 形近组共享 sup- 拼写；近义组收集一天中的其他餐食。

entries.definition: a liquid dish made by boiling food in water
entries.definitionCN: 汤；一般认为与 supper 同源相关

entries.definition: very good; a prefix meaning above
entries.definitionCN: 极好的；表示「在上」的前缀，与 supper 只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: the main meal of the day, often in the evening
entries.definitionCN: 正餐、主餐，常指晚上的主餐

entries.definition: the first meal of the day

normalIntro.en: Supper names the evening meal, from an old word for sipping soup.

The Last Supper is a famous religious scene.

root: supper 一般认为源自日耳曼语系一个表示「进食、啜汤」的词根（重构形式 *sup-，存疑），经古法语 souper（吃晚餐）于十三世纪进入英语，一直指傍晚或晚上吃的饭。
